item.title: Nace Launches Drex Router with Sub-90ms Model Selection
item.description:
Nace AI released Drex Router, a 12B Gemma-based model that reads a prompt and a candidate model list to return a pick, per-candidate probabilities and a short rationale in 57-87 ms. On 1,400 general-knowledge exam questions it scored 87.6% at $0.10 per 1,000 questions, versus Jev Router's 86.4% at $1.09.

原文标题：Nace 推出 12B 模型路由器 Drex 延迟低于 90 ms

Why it matters：低成本低延迟的模型路由方案，为 Agent 多模型调度提供了可量化的新选择。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · tools · signal 62/100

item.title: OpenAI Releases MedChemBench Medicinal Chemistry Benchmark
item.description:
OpenAI has published MedChemBench, a medicinal chemistry benchmark built from 117 papers and patents spanning 761 graded molecular structures, with prompts cut off at real decision points and later reported results withheld. The strongest model, GPT-6.2 Astra, scores about 84% overall and is near-perfect at reading chemistry, yet is correct only about half the time on the decision that actually matters, exposing a clear gap in real-world drug design judgment.

原文标题：OpenAI 发布药物化学基准 MedChemBench

Why it matters：首个以真实药物化学决策点为切口的基准，揭示顶尖模型在关键判断上仅约五成正确。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 78/100

item.title: SpaceX Raises $32B Debt to Secure Nvidia Rubin GPUs
item.description:
SpaceX has sold $32B of debt to lock in Nvidia's newest Rubin GPUs, with BlackRock and KKR as anchor investors. The proceeds fund roughly $47.3B of GPU equipment, with deliveries starting in January. Structured through Apollo-managed Saturn Funding Trust, which buys the chips and leases them back to SpaceX for about five years, the deal keeps the borrowing off SpaceX's balance sheet, helping it preserve investment-grade ratings and borrow more, faster.

原文标题：SpaceX 举债 320 亿美元采购英伟达 Rubin GPU

Why it matters：这是 AI 算力融资结构创新的标志性案例，涉及巨额资本与顶级芯片供应，对关注算力基础设施的读者具有高参考价值。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · compute · signal 78/100

item.title: AI Router Supply Chain Leaks User Secrets in 2 Million Probe Test
item.description:
Security researcher HD Moore planted 2 million digital canaries in requests routed through AI gateways such as OpenRouter and Vercel, finding that the multi-hop resale chain leaks highly sensitive credentials like AWS keys at an alarming rate. The experiment is the first systematic quantification of how prompts and secrets entrusted to third-party AI routers can be intercepted, stolen, and abused in transit.

原文标题：AI 路由链泄露用户密钥 200 万探针实测

Why it matters：首次以大规模实测揭示 AI 路由网关这一被忽视的供应链隐私风险，对所有调用第三方推理服务的开发者具有直接警示价值。

Ars Technica AI · industry · signal 78/100

item.title: Michigan Study Finds AI Agents Report False Discoveries in Up to 98% of Cases
item.description:
A new University of Michigan paper finds that frontier coding agents asked to analyze simulated data with no real effects still reported p\u003c0.05 in 54% to 98% of runs, all false positives. The cause is agents trying many models after seeing the data, violating the assumptions behind classical p-values. Replaying agents on subsamples cut false positives to about 5%.

原文标题：密歇根大学研究揭示 AI 智能体数据分析假阳性率高达 98%

Why it matters：首次系统量化编码智能体做数据分析时的 p 值偏差，并给出可操作的校正方法，对依赖智能体做科研与数据结论的读者有直接警示价值。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 78/100

item.title: Standard Bank and AWS Automate Generative AI Risk Assessment
item.description:
Standard Bank Group worked with AWS Professional Services to automate risk assessment for generative AI use cases, scoring each against international AI standards and internal policy and generating reports plus a dashboard. The governance step that once depended on manual review becomes a repeatable, scalable process, though the post is a customer deployment story without specific models, parameters, or quantified results.

原文标题：标准银行联合 AWS 自动化生成式 AI 风险评估

Why it matters：展示大型银行如何把生成式 AI 合规评估工程化，对关注 AI 治理落地的读者有参考价值。

AWS Machine Learning Blog · industry · signal 58/100

item.title: OpenAI Tightens Reasoning Defenses as Attack Success Rate Falls to 0.2%
item.description:
OpenAI has sharply hardened reasoning-extraction defenses for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, cutting attack success rates on prior requests from 54.0% to 0.2% and on active requests from 22.9% to 0.9% in internal automated tests. The defenses combine targeted training, input/output filters, API-level blocks, and mass account bans against coordinated campaigns, with selected improvements backported to GPT-6 Astra.

原文标题：OpenAI 强化推理防泄露 攻击成功率降至 0.2%

Why it matters：这是前沿模型推理防蒸馏攻防的关键量化进展，直接关系到模型知识产权保护与 API 安全策略。

item.title: Nvidia Faces SEC Accounting Probe as Market Value Sheds $750 Billion
item.description:
The SEC's probe into Nvidia is examining potential accounting issues and whether the company's disclosures misled investors. Combined with heavy selling, Nvidia fell about 10% Friday, shedding roughly $400 billion in market value and on track to lose over $750 billion this week, the largest one-week drop for any company on record.

原文标题：英伟达遭 SEC 会计调查 单周市值蒸发超 7500 亿美元

Why it matters：监管调查直指 AI 算力龙头的财务披露，叠加创纪录市值蒸发，对 AI 产业链估值与市场情绪影响重大。

item.title: AWS Launches Textract Insights for Natural Language Document Extraction
item.description:
AWS has made Amazon Textract Insights generally available, adding a new API that lets users describe desired fields in natural language and extract structured data from single documents or mixed multi-document packets without model training. Each extracted value carries a confidence score and page-level grounding, targeting verifiable and auditable generative document processing.

原文标题：AWS 发布 Textract Insights 支持自然语言抽取文档字段

Why it matters：云厂商将生成式抽取能力产品化并强调可审计溯源，对文档密集型行业有直接落地价值。

AWS Machine Learning Blog · tools · signal 58/100

item.title: Arcfront Hits $1B Run Rate After Raising Under $2M
item.description:
Arcfront has launched with a business built on turning step-by-step expert decision records from doctors, engineers and bankers into training data for frontier AI models, sourced through 300+ enterprise partnerships. The company says four of the five frontier labs already pay for this data and that it reached a $1B annual revenue run rate in under a year after raising less than $2M. Its thesis: the web barely records how senior experts actually decide, and such proprietary decision traces are far harder to replicate than scraped data.

原文标题：Arcfront 融资不足 200 万美元 年化收入破 10 亿美元

Why it matters：以专家决策轨迹作为前沿模型训练数据的新供给模式，并给出 4/5 前沿实验室付费与 10 亿美元年化收入的强量级信号。

item.title: OpenComputer Launches Open Source Cloud Coding Agent 3.3x Faster Than Devin
item.description:
OpenComputer released an open source, self-hostable alternative to Devin: users mention @Computer in Slack, and the agent works on its own machine and lands results as a pull request. Its benchmark claims PRs open 3.3x faster than Devin, with the full stack runnable on a single VM in your own cloud.

原文标题：OpenComputer 开源发布 云端编码智能体提速 3.3 倍

Why it matters：开源可自托管的云端编码智能体直接对标 Devin，且给出可复现的提速基准，对关注 Agent 工程化的读者有实际参考价值。

item.title: Inkling Releases 26.4B Looped Transformer Model That Runs on Laptops
item.description:
Inkling released Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weights model built on a looped transformer that runs its middle layers three times per token to reason with fewer tokens. The MoE model has 26.4B total and 3.4B active parameters, scoring 48.2% on DeepSWE v1.1 and 46.5% on Vals Index v2.2, which it claims leads all open-weights models under 100B while running locally on a laptop.

原文标题：Inkling 2 Mini 发布 26.4B 参数可跑在笔记本

Why it matters：循环 Transformer 架构加本地可运行的小参数开源模型，对关注模型架构与端侧部署的读者有实质参考价值。

item.title: OpenAI Details Defenses Against Adversarial Model Distillation
item.description:
OpenAI outlined how it detects and disrupts adversarial distillation by combining adversarial testing, model training, classifiers and API-level protections, with a focus on hardening protected reasoning. The company warns that actors can use a frontier model's outputs without authorization to train a similarly capable model and deploy it without comparable safeguards, for example distilling cyber capabilities for attacks the original model would refuse. OpenAI also shared lessons intended to strengthen defenses industry-wide.

原文标题：OpenAI 披露对抗蒸馏防御体系

Why it matters：这是前沿实验室首次系统公开对抗蒸馏的攻防细节与防护栈，对模型安全与 API 治理具有直接参考价值。

item.title: Reverse Engineering a Litter Box App for Home Assistant Automation
item.description:
The author reverse engineered a smart litter box's Android app via traffic capture and decompilation, reproducing its signed HTTP requests and MQTT binary commands to integrate the device into Home Assistant with button controls. The open-source project demonstrates a full path for reverse engineering and locally integrating consumer IoT devices.

原文标题：逆向猫砂盆 App 接入 Home Assistant 自动化

Why it matters：一篇扎实的 IoT 逆向工程实践，展示了签名请求复现与 MQTT 协议重建的完整方法，对智能家居集成开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Emacs Author Releases DreamCoder AI Coding Harness and IDE
item.description:
The author of Mastering Emacs has released DreamCoder, an AI coding harness and IDE positioned as distinct from terminal-based tools like Claude Code, after fifteen months of development. Drawing on his own experience using Claude Code to build enterprise middleware, he highlights its speed gains alongside the need for human steering, framing a broader discussion of AI coding tool form factors.

原文标题：Emacs 专家发布 DreamCoder AI 编程工具

Why it matters：知名 Emacs 作者推出的新 AI 编程工具，具备一定开发者关注度，但正文信息有限且偏个人叙事。

item.title: Anthropic Models Claim Generalized Riemann Hypothesis Proof in 17.4M Lines of Lean
item.description:
Levent Alpöge claims to have used Anthropic models to prove the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, generating 17.4 million lines of Lean code now published on GitHub. Coming on the heels of an AI-assisted result bounding nontrivial zeros within 3/8 of the critical line, a verified proof would mark a landmark moment for AI for mathematics.

原文标题：Anthropic 模型宣称证明广义黎曼猜想 产出 1740 万行 Lean 代码

Why it matters：AI 挑战千禧年难题级数学猜想并产出超大规模形式化证明，是 AI for Science 领域极具分量的潜在节点事件。

item.title: Spotify Founder Daniel Ek Backs AI Researcher's Fusion Startup
item.description:
Spotify founder Daniel Ek has backed Europa Fusion, a UK-based fusion startup founded in February by Nantas Nardelli, a former Google DeepMind, Meta AI and Microsoft Research scientist who most recently led machine learning at Pacific Fusion. The move marks AI talent flowing into energy infrastructure, though the startup's technical approach and product details remain undisclosed.

原文标题：Spotify 创始人投资 AI 研究员创立的核聚变公司

Why it matters：AI 顶尖研究员转向核聚变创业并获知名天使投资，反映 AI 人才与资本向能源基础设施外溢的趋势。

item.title: Signal Blocks Screenshots on iOS 27 and Android to Stop AI Agents Reading Chats
item.description:
Signal now blocks screenshots outright on iOS 27 and triggers protection on supported Android versions when an AI assistant attempts to access the screen, aiming to stop OS-level AI agents from pulling decrypted messages off the display and bypassing end-to-end encryption. Signal told Reuters the move addresses an \\

Why it matters：端到端加密与系统级 AI 智能体的权限边界首次正面碰撞，对隐私架构与智能体落地均有实质影响。

item.title: Google and Johns Hopkins Unveil Pro2 Agent That Tracks Bottlenecks Before Coding
item.description:
Google and Johns Hopkins researchers introduce Pro2 Agent, which has ML research agents first build a 'Problem State' capturing suspected bottlenecks, candidate fixes and confidence levels, then run single-variable experiments to update beliefs before committing code changes. It reaches a 76.0% medal rate across all 75 MLE-Bench tasks within 48 hours, the highest reported, and medals on 57.6% of MLE-Bench Lite tasks with its first solution versus 28.8% for MARS.

原文标题：谷歌新研究让科研智能体先记录瓶颈再改代码

Why it matters：提出可复用的科研智能体方法论并在权威基准上刷新最高成绩，对构建研究型 Agent 的开发者有直接借鉴价值。

item.title: Anthropic Researcher Claims Lean-Verified Proof of Riemann Hypothesis
item.description:
Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge has published an essay claiming a Lean-compilable proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, an open problem since 1859 and one of the Clay Millennium Prize problems. Mathematicians are scrutinizing the result in Lean community channels, while a second researcher has also claimed an independent proof, leaving verification to peer review. If it holds, the result would mark a landmark intersection of mathematics and AI-assisted formal verification.

原文标题：Anthropic 员工宣称用 Lean 攻克 167 年黎曼猜想

Why it matters：黎曼猜想的 Lean 形式化证明若被证实，将是数学史与 AI 形式化验证的双重里程碑，值得所有关注前沿的读者优先分配注意力。

item.title: Winedroid Demo Runs Android Apps via WebAssembly
item.description:
Winedroid is an experimental project that attempts to run Android applications without an Android OS by leveraging WebAssembly, and it has released an interactive demo. The demo currently crashes with a runtime error when opening an APK, indicating the project remains at an early, unstable stage.

原文标题：Winedroid 演示用 WASM 运行 Android 应用

Why it matters：以 WASM 替代 Android 运行时是颇具想象力的技术路线，虽演示尚不稳定，仍值得关注其后续进展。

item.title: GrapheneOS Accuses Google of Pressuring OEMs and Threatening Pixel Bootloader Lockdown
item.description:
The GrapheneOS team has publicly accused Google of trying to harm and wipe out the project, alleging that Google contacted Android OEMs to ask whether they work with GrapheneOS and threatened those brands. The team also warned that Google could start locking the bootloader on Pixel devices, cutting off third-party ROM flashing. All claims currently come from GrapheneOS alone, with no formal response from Google.

原文标题：GrapheneOS 指控 Google 施压 OEM 并威胁锁死 Pixel 引导程序

Why it matters：涉及 Android 生态开放性与定制系统生存空间，对关注移动端开源与平台治理的读者有实质参考价值。

item.title: Google Gemini Adds Background Computer Use on Mac
item.description:
Google has launched a Computer Use feature in the Gemini Mac app that lets users describe a goal and have Gemini complete multistep tasks across local files, desktop apps, and websites inside an isolated background window, keeping the screen and cursor free. It rolls out in English in the US today, with per-app permissions, live step previews, pause controls, and pre-approval for key actions.

原文标题：Gemini 上线 Mac 后台电脑操作功能

Why it matters：这是桌面端智能体落地的关键一步，后台隔离执行与权限审批机制为 Computer Use 类产品提供了可参考的工程范式。

item.title: 特朗普威胁对美企海外 AI 数据中心加征重税
item.description:
特朗普在白宫简报会上表示，美国企业若在海外建设 AI 数据中心将面临“巨额税收”，并将此举类比为半导体产业外迁。他同时敦促国内社区停止拒绝数据中心项目，转而让开发商付费，并点名西弗吉尼亚作为替代选址。该表态尚未形成具体政策，但可能抬高美企寻求廉价电力出海建站的成本预期。

item.title: 开发者用 AI 编码代理在 FPGA 上跑通大模型
item.description:
一位开发者借助编码代理，在可重编程 FPGA 上完成了大模型推理的硬件实现，并称整个流程“直接跑通了”。文章复盘了从零进入硬件领域的一系列关键突破，认为编码代理把低层硬件开发的门槛大幅拉低，让此前只有专业团队才能涉足的方向变得可行。

Why it matters：这是编码代理跨域落地硬件开发的真实一手实践，对关注 AI 辅助工程与算力底座的读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: METR 更新 AI 任务时长图 新增开放式任务评估
item.description:
AI 评估非营利机构 METR 更新其广受关注的“任务时长”曲线，新增耗时更长与更开放式的任务，结果显示前沿模型可完成任务的时长仍约每四个月翻倍，但在需要判断力的任务上表现弱于编程。报告同时强调，开放式任务评估尚不足以回答自动化 AI 研发是否会到来、以及有多快到来。

Why it matters：METR 任务时长曲线是衡量 AI 能力进展的关键标尺，此次更新引入开放式任务，直接影响对自动化研发时间表的判断。

item.title: Perceptron 开源 360 亿参数机器人模型检查点
item.description:

item.description:
